name: Tanimoto Mitsuki
source:
The protagonist's older sister. A bright, lively, talkative, and sociable girl. A virgin.

Though she was already academically strong, she hired a tutor to aim for a higher-ranked university. She respects Honoka as a dependable older sister figure.

She constantly belittles her younger brother without restraint, believing she must protect him.

[From [url=https://www.ume.gr.jp/product/ume/katekyo/chr2.html]official site[/url]]
